Ukraine Accuses US of Intelligence Lapse Amid Russian Missile Strikes on Kyiv

Ukraine has accused the United States of restricting intelligence sharing about Russian missile launches, with a senior official stating that the US had threatened to stop providing such information in recent days. This accusation follows Russian missile strikes on Kyiv, including one that hit the CHP-4 power plant. President Zelensky stated that Ukraine received no advance warning from partners about the missiles headed to Kyiv, suggesting the attacks and Starlink restrictions were more than a coincidence. The attacks occurred despite claims by Donald Trump that an energy ceasefire was in effect.
